Game Overview

Escape from the Dungeon is a platformer title where dive into the heart-pounding depths of a medieval dungeon where survival hinges on your wits and timing. Navigate tricky traps, uncover secret paths, and collect keys to escape. With its nostalgic pixel-art charm and increasingly intricate puzzles, this adventure challenges you to perfect your escape strategy.
